summary: Hernandez declined to label Israel's Gaza actions as genocide at an April 2026 Indivisible forum, diverging from fellow candidates and the Alameda County Democratic Party. Her questionnaire responses endorse continued U.S. security assistance to Israel and reject the Global BDS Movement. AIPAC-aligned super PACs spent heavily in her support: UDP over $825,000 and BOLD America, which received UDP funding in 2026, nearly $1.8 million.
